source.title: After the Midterms: What Now for Bitcoin?
source.description: Daily Bitcoin news and analysis. In this episode we go through the week's price action, the on-chain data we watch, and your questions from the comments. Chapters: 00:00 Intro 01:12 Price action 06:40 On-chain 11:05 Your questions 18:30 Wrap-up. If you enjoy the show, subscribe and turn on notifications so you never miss an episode, and share it with a friend who is just getting started. Nothing in this video is financial advice; always do your own research before making any decision with your money. Thank you for watching, for the comments and for the support, and we will see you on the next
